safe_state.switch: hold the learning state file unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not migrate, edit, or prune decision history automatically; unreadable history may contain human decisions that are not recoverable elsewhere.

sampling.what: Daily learning-summary availability and count of decision types, without proposal text or mismatch reasons.
sampling.working_well: The learn command reads the current or legacy state path and returns a structured decision summary without exposing decision contents.

open_decisions: Decide whether an absent state file means a valid empty learning history or an initialization problem; the current CLI treats it as empty.
